answer: Each identity builds a trellis of standing, one link at a time — each link is a piece of real work, and each link must be verified by a different stranger drawn at random from established identities, so no single friend can vouch for the whole chain. A beacon of trust shines only from a trellis whose every link was checked by someone new, and an atlas of standing grows slowly, link by verified link, so a farm of a thousand fakes stays bare: each fake needs a fresh stranger to verify each link, and strangers do not vouch for work they have not seen.
